children: Mission Produce reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $450.0 million, a 26% year-over-year increase, and a net loss attributable to Mission Produce of $6.5 million ($(0.08) diluted). Adjusted net income was $15.0 million, or $0.18 per diluted share, and adjusted EBITDA was $32.4 million. Management raised the estimated annualized synergies from the Calavo acquisition to more than $30 million and reaffirmed second-half Adjusted EBITDA guidance.
Total revenue: $450.0 million for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 (up 26% vs. prior year).
Gross profit: $44.7 million; gross margin: 9.9% of revenue (down 270 basis points vs. prior year).
Operating income: $0.5 million for the quarter.
Net (loss) income attributable to Mission Produce: $(6.5) million, or $(0.08) per diluted share (includes $25.4 million pre-tax Calavo acquisition-related costs).
Adjusted net income: $15.0 million, or $0.18 per diluted share; Adjusted EBITDA: $32.4 million.
Avocado volume growth: Pounds sold increased to 252.7 million in the quarter (38% growth vs. same period last year), driven by integration of the acquired Calavo operation and higher Mexican supply.
Marketing & Distribution: Segment sales of $414.3 million with segment adjusted EBITDA of $24.7 million—benefiting from inclusion of Calavo's post-acquisition results and distribution execution.

International Farming: Segment sales were $45.8 million; performance affected by lower average sales prices amid higher global avocado supply, with adjusted EBITDA of $7.6 million concentrated in harvest season timing.

Prepared Foods and Blueberries: Mission entered the prepared foods category through the Calavo acquisition (Prepared Foods sales $15.5 million); Blueberries segment benefited from IEEPA tariff refunds and recorded segment operating income improvement.

Acquisition integration: Calavo acquisition completed May 28, 2026—consideration included 17,530,762 shares and ≈$267 million cash; integration work drove transaction advisory and integration costs and has led management to raise expected annualized synergies to more than $30 million.
